required_assumptions: K2(m,n) does not depend on the external labels a,b,c except through the attached h1/h2 factor

For the True branch: K2_offdiag_from_S1(m,n) - K2_offdiag_from_S2(m,n) = 0
hypotheses.rationale: The first two double sums have identical polygamma and rational coefficient structure; only the h1/h2 prefactors differ by a permutation of the labels b and c.

hypotheses.rationale: The third and fourth triple sums contain the same five branch coefficient blocks; only the h1 index pattern changes from one cyclic orientation to another.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Replace each polygamma(k, argument) in the raw expression by P_k(z_{s,j}) after matching the argument to the corresponding signed shifted variable z_{+j} or z_{-j}. Leave all polynomial, rational, denominator, and h1/h2 prefactors unchanged.
required_assumptions: z_{+j} and z_{-j} are treated as separate symbolic basis arguments except where equality of epsilon values or mu forces coincidences
The only polygamma orders appearing are k=0 through k=4
proof_obligations: For every polygamma term in S1-S4, the original argument minus the matched z_{s,j} is identically zero
No polygamma argument in S1-S4 lies outside the two signed-index families
The coefficient of each P_k(z_{s,j}) is exactly the original rational/polynomial coefficient after substitution
hypotheses.rationale: All polygamma arguments in the entire expression are of the two shifted sign-index forms. This reduces the apparent variation to a finite basis of polygamma evaluations with coefficients carrying the remaining index and degeneracy structure.
